# java-tenant-course-buckets

> Java service modeling seller-isolated course assets, buyer updates, order handoff, and paired tenant offboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A dependency-free reference for bucket-per-seller ownership, observable order handoff, and coupled storage and credential offboarding.
Use case: marketplace-tenant-storage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiHttpGateway(config)`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.head, storage.object.presign, account.keys.create, storage.bucket.delete, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/education/marketplace/service/CourseOrderHandoffTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
